gate.basis: Recorded engineering acceptance agreement: 4 ms physics step, 12 ms maximum. The 12.5 ms rotor time constant is context, not proof of policy delay tolerance or stability.

definitions.motor_rms: RMS over [change, change+0.5 s) (1 ms zero-order hold) and four motors of run minus the in-batch RAPTOR continuous-hover baseline mean curve aligned at its re-capture; baseline runs use the leave-one-out mean
definitions.gru_distance: Euclidean distance between the committed GRU at the given offset after the change and the in-batch baseline mean at the same offset after its re-capture
definitions.elimination_ratio: (N0 - Nx) / (N0 - baseline) of group means at the second C->N within one deactivation condition
definitions.memory_length: Exact offline replay of the frozen policy (Dense 22-16 ReLU, GRU 16, Dense 16-4) on logged SITL inputs: raptor_input observation and research_memory previous_action averaged over the control calls since the last native step (rl_tools executor action_history), native steps only. Validated per run by reproducing the logged GRU from the logged state. Memory length = native steps (and seconds) after which the GRU replayed from a different initial memory stays within the threshold of the GRU with the complete history, on the same logged inputs.

scope: One frozen candidate, headless SITL only. Repeats share seed and configuration; exploratory budget, not a statistical test.
